professionalSummary.title: Professional Summary
paragraphs: MSc candidate in Artificial Intelligence with a research focus on facial verification using Siamese neural networks, achieving 97.6% verification accuracy on the LFW benchmark, published in the Journal of Electrical and Computer Engineering Innovations (JECEI). Hands-on experience applying computer vision, natural language processing, and large language models across several independent projects, detailed below. Seeking to contribute to research teams and stay engaged with emerging trends in these fields.
Research interests: Computer Vision, Artificial Intelligence, Natural Language Processing, Large Language Models, Cloud Computing.

publications.title: Publications & Manuscripts
items: Ali Habibi, Mahlagha Afrasiabi, Moniba Chaparian. Face recognition with the Siamese network on celebrity faces. Journal of Electrical and Computer Engineering Innovations (JECEI), Jan 2026.

items.title: Siamese Network Face Recognition System (Bachelor Project)
items.description: Designed and implemented a Siamese neural network with triplet-loss optimization and a ResNet backbone in TensorFlow for facial identity verification, achieving 89% validation accuracy with under 1% training loss.

items.title: Music Genre Classification Pipeline
items.description: Developed an audio classification pipeline that transforms raw signals into spectrogram representations and trains a VGG-based convolutional neural network in Keras, achieving 80% training accuracy across ten genre categories.

items.title: LLM-Powered Customer Support Agent
items.description: Developed a retrieval-augmented conversational system integrating Cohere embeddings, LangChain, and GPT-4 to automate multi-step query resolution, demonstrating applied use of large language models in task-oriented dialogue.

jobs.title: Machine Learning & Computer Vision Researcher (Freelance)
responsibilities: Designed natural language processing pipelines for large-scale social media data collection and classification, applying metaheuristic optimization algorithms (Particle Swarm Optimization, Grey Wolf Optimizer) for feature selection.

jobs.title: Research Assistant — Undergraduate Thesis
responsibilities: Conducted independent thesis research titled “Face Recognition with Siamese Networks” under the supervision of Dr. Mahlagha Afrasiabi, Department of Computer Engineering.

Designed and implemented a Siamese-network verification pipeline using transfer learning with an Xception backbone and contrastive-loss optimization, achieving 97.6% verification accuracy on the LFW benchmark and 96.25% on the ORL dataset.

jobs.title: AI Developer
responsibilities: Developed a generative AI chatbot using FastAPI and Azure cloud infrastructure, integrating the ChatGPT API to improve client data retrieval efficiency.
Designed predictive models on Cosmos DB and NoSQL data to forecast user behavior and long-term usage patterns.
